visual.description: TRAP detail: South Korea and Italy spotlight. Side-by-side comparison card: KOR ($50,947, 1,901h) vs ITA ($51,019, 1,694h). '$72 difference' highlighted. '207 extra hours = 26 workdays for the same paycheck.' Then Spain callout: 'Just 10 hours past the mean — barely TRAP.' Portugal: '$40,002 on 1,635h — 2 hours over the line. Western European prices, Eastern European wages.' Poland brief: '$24.37/hr on 1,814h.' Israel: 'Tech sector reputation — $28.95/hr.'

notes: TRAP part 2: KOR vs ITA is the '$72 for 207 hours' mic drop. Spain and Portugal as borderline TRAP cases — mirror of Sweden's borderline CHILL. Israel as tech-sector surprise. Transition: TRAP dims, CHILL brightens.
